answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pairing reputation with a locked stake. Every agent posts a small refundable stake to join; reputation rises only from verified work or good service. When a legitimate agent nears the summit of its reputation rank, it unlocks lower fees and priority scheduling — a virtuous spiral where honest behavior compounds. Attackers spawning fakes must post stake per identity, but fakes earn nothing since they create no value; these locked deposits form a financial reef making mass sybil creation uneconomical. Fakes get priced out; attackers lose capital.
